import networkx as nx

def is_k_connected(n, edges, k):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(range(n))
    G.add_edges_from(edges)
    return nx.node_connectivity(G) >= k

edges = []
for i in range(11):
    edges.append((i, (i + 1) % 11))
    edges.append((i, (i + 2) % 11))

# Remove duplicates (if any) and ensure u < v
unique_edges = set()
for u, v in edges:
    if u > v:
        u, v = v, u
    if u != v:
        unique_edges.add((u, v))

print(f"Number of edges: {len(unique_edges)}")
print(f"Is 4-connected: {is_k_connected(11, list(unique_edges), 4)}")
print(f"Edges: {sorted(list(unique_edges))}")
